name: mæchlæng LAB
status: LAB · beta · demo · read-only for robots · noindex
description: æ authority (æ0–æ3) and the Asimov robot face written as Mech state machines and run live on the real Mech runtime (wasm, vendored, no CDN). Static page, no server.

agent_mode.note: Needs JavaScript: the page swaps itself for a plain-text/JSON summary (state + API + links). Headless fetchers without JS: read this file and llms.txt.

doctrine.roles: Many agents. One principal. Human stays root.
doctrine.agents: Agents relay context and evidence. An agent may act at æ0 (public) and æ1 (published).
doctrine.principal: Only the human principal grants æ2 (operator) and æ3 (custody), and only with pk && wr: the principal's passkey AND a Witness receipt.
doctrine.pk_on_this_page: SIMULATED. Any caller can pass pk:true here, so a :Granted on this LAB page is a demo, never authority. A real æ2/æ3 grant needs the human principal's own passkey (WebAuthn), outside this page.
doctrine.robot: The face is read-only, robot authority æ1: it shows state, it never moves a robot.

pk.description: principal passkey (simulated here; only boolean true counts)

wr.description: Witness receipt present (only boolean true counts)

machines.invariant: level ≥ 2 and not (pk && wr) ⇒ evidence (never granted)
machines.js: await MAECH.authority({agent, level, pk, wr}) → {state, granted, fsm, needs, simulated, receipt}

machines.rules: first match wins: fault ∨ FAULT_DAMP ⇒ hold · stale ⇒ lost · battery < 20 ⇒ tired · DAMP ⇒ sleep · STAND ¬armed ⇒ think · STAND armed ⇒ ready · MOVE ⇒ work · else ⇒ lost
machines.js: await MAECH.face({md, armed, fault, stale, battery}) → ae.face/0.1 JSON

methods.note: fresh WasmMech per run; throws on Mech error; after await MAECH.ready

methods.returns: {state, granted, fsm, needs, engine, simulated, receipt}

methods.call: await MAECH.face({md, armed, fault, stale, battery}, {show})
methods.returns: ae.face/0.1 JSON; show:true also drives the page face
[{n, prev, h, event}] · h(n) = sha256(h(n-1) + '|' + JSON(event)), h(0) = sha256('GENESIS')

runtime.wasm_sha256_of: the decompressed .wasm; runtime/maech-run.js refuses to start if it differs
runtime.node: import mod from mech_wasm.js; mod.initSync({module: gunzip(wasm)}); new mod.WasmMech(); run_program(src); out_string()

how_to_run: Browser: open https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/maechlang/ and in the console: await MAECH.ready; await MAECH.face({md:'STAND', armed:true})
Any Mech: paste authority.mec or face.mec into https://try.mech-lang.org (note: try. serves an older 0.3.1 without state machines; use the vendored 0.3.5)
Node: clone LutheranInstitute/aeee-lab (branch lab) and run: node lab/maechlang/test.mjs

robots: noindex for search engines; agents welcome to fetch llms.txt and agent.json
